numerical_simulation_of_shsvd.solve_shsvd.solve_hsvd¶

numerical_simulation_of_shsvd.solve_shsvd.solve_hsvd(flow_function, initial_value, t_span, jump_times=None, jump_time_transition_function=None, jump_set_function=None, jump_set_transition_function=None, t_eval=None, flow_args=None, jump_time_transition_args=None, jump_set_args=None, jump_set_transition_args=None, solve_ivp_method='RK45', **solve_ivp_options)¶

Solves a hybrid system of variable dimension.

This function integrates the flow of a system defined by the flow_function over a specified time span, accounting for possible transitions defined by the transition_function and jump events defined by jump_set_function as well as preset jump_times.

Parameters:

  • flow_function (callable) – The function that defines the flow of the system.

  • initial_value (array-like) – The initial state of the system.

  • t_span (tuple) – A tuple specifying the start and end times for integration.

  • jump_times (list, optional) – A list of times at which jumps occur.

  • jump_time_transition_function (callable, optional) – The function that defines the transition behavior at jump times.

  • jump_set_function (callable, optional) – A function that defines the conditions for a jump to occur.

  • jump_set_transition_function (callable, optional) – A function that defines the transition at jump sets. It is set to jump_time_transition_function if none is provided.

  • t_eval (array-like, optional) – Specific times at which to store the computed solution.

  • flow_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the flow_function.

  • jump_time_transition_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the jump_time_transition_function.

  • jump_set_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the jump_set_function.

  • jump_set_transition_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the jump_set_transition_function.

  • solve_ivp_method (str, optional) – The method to use for solving the initial value problem (default is ‘RK45’).

  • solve_ivp_options (keyword arguments, optional) – Additional options for the solve_ivp function.

Returns:

func – An object containing the time and value data of the system after integration.

Return type:

FunctionOfVariableDimension

Raises:

ValueError – If jump time/set transition function is not given although jump times/set are given.
